title: Guest Tony on how a moaning Mac app made $44K in 60 days via two viral reels
summary: Rob Hallam interviews guest Tony, who built Slap Mac in two days and made $44K in 60 days from two Instagram reels. Tony covers training the feed, hooks, a refund-for-reels incentive, and talking to users. Rob mostly asks questions, so these are Tony's views, not Rob's.
